notes.title: Thank You for Your Feedback!
notes.content: [h1]THANK YOU![/h1][p][/p][p]Thank you to every who played our Steam Next Fest Demo and an even bigger thank you to everyone who submitted feedback! We enjoyed the festival and are eager to show what we have changed thanks to your feedback![/p][p][/p][p]The 3 most common pieces of feedback we received were the following:[/p][list][*][p]Enemies were too small[/p][/*][*][p]The Tower Shop was a little tedious[/p][/*][*][p]Fast forward or time scale controls were needed[/p][/*][/list][p]We are happy to announce that we have changed/implemented [b]all[/b] of the above! [/p][list][*][p]The enemies are now much [b]bigger[/b] so that destroying them is more satisfying! [/p][/*][*][p]The tower shop no longer has a scroll bar and instead all the towers are [b]always visible[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]3 time scale buttons have been implemented allowing you to choose from [b]1x, 2x, [/b]and [b]3x[/b] speed![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Again we want to thank everyone who participated and gave feedback! You have all helped us make a better version of our game and we cannot wait to share the full game with you all very soon![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading[/p][p][/p][p][i]~ Monkey Tale Games[/i][/p]
